entries.en: The researcher questioned whether the damaged cells retained their albuminogenous capacity.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑，那些受损细胞是否仍保有产生白蛋白的能力。

entries.en: The old report's account of albuminolysin activity did not agree with the surviving laboratory notes.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告对溶清蛋白素活性的记述，与留存的实验室笔记并不一致。

entries.en: The diagram of albuminolysis lacked arrows, leaving the sequence of changes unclear.
entries.zh: 那张白蛋白分解图缺少箭头，因此变化的先后顺序不清楚。

entries.en: A crack in the albuminometer made the laboratory assistant question the earlier reading.
entries.zh: 白蛋白定量器上的一道裂缝让实验室助理对先前的读数产生了疑问。

entries.en: The researcher could not compare the albuminometry results without the original measurement records.
entries.zh: 没有原始测量记录，研究人员无法比较白蛋白定量结果。

entries.en: The physician recorded albuminoptysis in the case notes without identifying its cause.
entries.zh: 医生在病例记录中记下了白蛋白痰，却未查明其原因。

entries.meaningZh: 痰白蛋白反应〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old laboratory report included an albuminoreaction result, but the accompanying notes were illegible.
entries.zh: 那份旧实验室报告包含一项痰白蛋白反应结果，但随附笔记的字迹无法辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 白蛋白溢〔旧称；此处指白蛋白尿〕
entries.en: The historical account of albuminorrhea lacked the measurements needed for a detailed comparison.
entries.zh: 那份有关白蛋白尿的历史记述缺少详细比较所需的测量数据。

entries.meaningZh: 尿白蛋白测定器〔旧仪器〕
entries.en: The curator found the albuminoscope in a drawer beneath the old laboratory bench.
entries.zh: 馆员在旧实验台下的一个抽屉里找到了那台尿白蛋白测定器。

entries.en: The old report described an albuminose fluid but gave no details of its analysis.
entries.zh: 旧报告描述了一种含清蛋白的液体，却没有交代分析细节。

entries.meaningZh: 白蛋白增多〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The chapter on albuminosis was missing from the physician's worn copy of the handbook.
entries.zh: 医生那本破旧手册中，关于白蛋白增多的章节不见了。

entries.en: The old chart listed several supposedly albuminuretic substances without providing supporting observations.
entries.zh: 那张旧图表列出了几种据称可引起蛋白尿的物质，却没有提供支持性的观察记录。

entries.meaningZh: 蛋白尿恐惧〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old case history described albuminurophobia but gave little detail about the person's daily life.
entries.zh: 那份旧病史描述了对蛋白尿的恐惧，却几乎没有记述当事人的日常生活。

entries.en: The report described an albumoid coating, but its composition had not been established.
entries.zh: 报告描述了一层蛋白样涂层，但其成分尚未确定。

entries.en: The albumoscope stood beside a broken balance in the medical museum's storage room.
entries.zh: 那台尿白蛋白测定器放在医学博物馆库房里一台损坏的天平旁边。

entries.en: The reviewer requested the original albumosease measurements before accepting the revised table.
entries.zh: 审稿人要求先查看清蛋白酶的原始测量结果，再接受修订后的表格。

entries.en: The old laboratory file contained an albumotope order with the delivery page missing.
entries.zh: 那份实验室旧档案中有一张碘标记清蛋白和血清的订单，但缺少送货页。

entries.en: A loose strand of Albuna had caught in the sample book's stitching.
entries.zh: 一根松散的无光醋酯长丝缠在了样本册的缝线上。

entries.en: The old botanical drawing showed the alburnous layer in a different colour.
entries.zh: 那幅旧植物学图用另一种颜色标出了边材层。

entries.en: The carpenter left a narrow strip of alburnum along the edge of the plank.
entries.zh: 木匠在木板边缘留了一条窄窄的边材。

entries.en: The archivist compared two albutannin purchase orders and noticed that their quantities differed.
entries.zh: 档案管理员比较了两份鞣酸蛋白采购单，发现上面的数量不同。

entries.en: The albutoin analysis was delayed because the reference sample had arrived without its paperwork.
entries.zh: 由于送达的参比样品没有附上相关文件，阿布妥因分析被推迟了。

entries.en: Our tutor asked us to read the Alcaic stanza aloud before discussing its rhythm.
entries.zh: 导师让我们先大声朗读那节阿尔凯奥斯诗体的诗，再讨论它的韵律。

entries.en: The microbiologist compared the Alcaligenes isolates, but two culture records were missing.
entries.zh: 微生物学家比较了产碱杆菌属的分离菌株，但有两份培养记录不见了。

entries.en: We left our suitcases in Alcamo and took only a small bag for the afternoon trip.
entries.zh: 我们把行李箱留在阿尔卡莫，下午出游时只带了一个小包。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔刻提斯〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The actor playing Alcestis asked for a lighter costume before the evening rehearsal.
entries.zh: 饰演阿尔刻提斯的演员在晚间排练前要求换一套更轻便的戏服。

entries.en: The technician photographed the damaged Alchrome wire before sending the old heater for assessment.
entries.zh: 技术人员先拍下损坏的铁铬铝系电阻丝，再把旧加热器送去评估。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔克罗塔尔电阻合金
entries.en: The workshop's Alchrotal order had been filed with last year's invoices.
entries.zh: 车间的阿尔克罗塔尔电阻合金订单被归进了去年的发票中。

entries.en: The researcher compared the Alciopidae illustrations with the specimens recorded in the old collection catalogue.
entries.zh: 研究人员把浮沙蚕科的插图与旧馆藏目录中记载的标本作了比较。

entries.en: The technician found an unused sheet of Alclad beneath the aircraft drawings.
entries.zh: 技术员在飞机图纸下面找到了一张尚未使用的铝衣合金板。

entries.en: The analyst rejected the alclofenac result because the sample numbers did not match.
entries.zh: 由于样本编号不符，分析人员没有采纳那项阿氯芬酸检测结果。

entries.en: Several pages of the alclometasone study were missing from the archive copy.
entries.zh: 档案副本中有几页关于阿氯米松的研究内容缺失了。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔克墨涅〔希腊神话人物〕
entries.en: The director asked the actor playing Alcmene to move closer to the front of the stage.
entries.zh: 导演要求饰演阿尔克墨涅的演员向舞台前方靠近一些。

entries.en: The historian requested the original alcogas delivery records before accepting the revised budget figures.
entries.zh: 历史研究者要求先查看乙醇汽油混合物的原始交货记录，再接受修订后的预算数字。

entries.en: The damaged jar of alcogel was removed from the shipment before it left the warehouse.
entries.zh: 那罐包装受损的醇凝胶在发货出库前被移出了货物批次。

entries.en: The report on alcoholemia omitted the time at which the blood sample was collected.
entries.zh: 那份醇血症报告没有注明血样的采集时间。

entries.en: The assistant found the alcoholimeter in the wrong box after the equipment had been moved.
entries.zh: 设备搬动后，助理发现酒精比重计被放错了箱子。

entries.en: We could not compare the alcoholimetry results because the earlier measurements used a different method.
entries.zh: 由于先前的测量采用了另一种方法，我们无法比较这些醇定量结果。

entries.en: The two notebooks gave conflicting accounts of the specimen's alcoholization.
entries.zh: 两本笔记对该标本醇化过程的记述相互矛盾。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether contamination could explain the reported alcoholuria.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，报告中尿液含醇的情况是否可能由污染引起。

entries.en: Their report on alcoholysis was returned because the results table lacked sample numbers.
entries.zh: 他们关于醇解的报告被退回了，因为结果表缺少样本编号。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔科麦克斯永磁材料
entries.en: The Alcomax magnet had come loose inside the instrument, so the restorer documented its original position.
entries.zh: 仪器内的阿尔科麦克斯磁体已经松脱，因此修复人员记录了它的原始位置。

entries.meaningZh: 测醉仪〔旧式呼气酒精检测装置〕
entries.en: The curator requested photographs of the Alcometer before deciding how to display the instrument.
entries.zh: 策展人要求先查看那台旧式呼气测醉仪的照片，再决定如何陈列这件仪器。

entries.en: Clouds hid Alcor before our group could finish sketching the star field.
entries.zh: 我们小组还没画完那片星野，云就遮住了恒星 Alcor。

entries.en: He placed his paternal grandfather's worn Alcoran in a protective case before moving the books.
entries.zh: 搬书前，他把祖父那本破旧的《古兰经》放进了保护盒。

entries.en: The chemist compared the proposed structures of the metal alcoxides in the old paper.
entries.zh: 那位化学研究者比较了旧论文所提出的几种烃氧基金属的结构。

entries.en: Her postcard from Alcoy arrived after she had already returned home.
entries.zh: 她从阿尔科伊寄出的明信片，在她回家后才送到。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔克雷斯铁铬铝电阻合金
entries.en: The archivist compared the Alcress invoice with a handwritten list of workshop materials.
entries.zh: 档案员把阿尔克雷斯铁铬铝电阻合金的发票与一份手写车间材料清单作了比较。

entries.en: The engineer checked the old Alcumite pipe drawings against the surviving maintenance records.
entries.zh: 工程师对照保存下来的维护记录，核查了旧阿尔库麦特铜合金管道的图纸。

entries.en: She compared two old photographs of Aldabra Atoll before choosing one for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 她比较了两张阿尔达布拉环礁的旧照片，再选出一张用于展览。

entries.en: The reviewer returned the aldactone study because several references could not be traced.
entries.zh: 审稿人退回了那篇螺内酯研究论文，因为其中几条参考文献无法查到。

entries.en: The Aldal sample was missing from the display, although its catalogue photograph was still available.
entries.zh: 陈列中不见了那件阿尔达尔铝合金样品，不过目录中的照片还在。

entries.en: An old invoice for aldamine had been filed among the supplier's unrelated shipping documents.
entries.zh: 一张旧乙醛氨产品发票被归入了供应商那些不相关的运输文件中。

entries.en: The faded map showed the Aldan, but several place names along its banks were unreadable.
entries.zh: 那张褪色地图上画着阿尔丹河，但沿岸有几个地名已经无法辨认。

entries.en: The pharmacist compared an old Aldara carton with the supplier's archived product record.
entries.zh: 药剂师把一个旧的Aldara乳膏包装盒与供应商归档的产品记录作了比较。

entries.en: The historian compared the Aldecor steel order with the contractor's handwritten material list.
entries.zh: 历史研究者把那份高强度低合金钢订单与承包商手写的材料清单作了比较。

entries.en: The revised catalogue listed the aldehyde-amines separately from the other nitrogen compounds.
entries.zh: 修订后的目录把醛胺类与其他含氮化合物分开列出。

entries.en: The chemist requested a clearer spectrum before accepting the proposed identification of aldehydine.
entries.zh: 那位化学研究者要求先看到更清晰的谱图，再接受将样品鉴定为乙基甲基吡啶的提议。

entries.en: The proposed aldehydo-ester structure was redrawn after the reviewer noticed an inconsistency.
entries.zh: 审稿人发现一处矛盾后，所提出的醛酯结构被重新绘制。

entries.en: The two reports gave different accounts of the aldgamycin sample's origin.
entries.zh: 两份报告对那份阿德加霉素样品的来源有不同记述。

entries.en: The laboratory requested a second soil sample before confirming the aldicarb finding.
entries.zh: 实验室要求提供第二份土壤样本，之后才会确认那项涕灭威检测结果。

entries.en: The chemist compared the aldimine spectrum with an earlier measurement before revising the report.
entries.zh: 化学家把醛亚胺的光谱与先前的测量结果作了比较，然后才修改报告。

entries.en: The old laboratory account described an aldin but left its precise identity uncertain.
entries.zh: 那份旧实验室记录描述了一种醛碱，却未明确其具体身份。

entries.en: The curator compared two Aldine editions before examining their handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 策展人先比较了两种阿尔定版古籍，再查看其中的手写批注。

entries.en: The archived Aldip cost estimate omitted the transport charges included in the competing proposal.
entries.zh: 那份存档的热浸渗铝方案费用估算没有计入运输费，而另一份方案计入了这项费用。

entries.meaningZh: 奥尔迪斯手提信号灯〔限 Aldis lamp〕
entries.en: We found the missing Aldis lamp beneath a folded blanket in the storeroom.
entries.zh: 我们在储藏室里一条叠好的毯子下面找到了失踪的奥尔迪斯手提信号灯。

entries.en: The reviewer asked for clearer structural drawings of the aldoketens discussed in the paper.
entries.zh: 审稿人要求提供更清晰的结构图，以说明论文所讨论的醛烯酮类化合物。

entries.en: The researcher compared aldoketomutase activity in the two sets of archived measurements.
entries.zh: 那位研究者比较了两组归档测量记录中的醛酮变位酶活性。

entries.en: The researchers repeated the aldolase measurements after discovering that two sample codes had been switched.
entries.zh: 研究人员发现两个样本的代码被调换后，重新进行了醛缩酶测量。

entries.en: The graduate student had to repeat the aldolization experiment after losing the original data file.
entries.zh: 由于原始数据文件丢失，那位研究生不得不重做羟醛缩合实验。

entries.meaningZh: 铝镁硅合金〔Aldrey 的异拼〕
entries.en: The old Aldray cable invoice gave a delivery date but no length for the cable.
entries.zh: 那张旧铝镁硅合金电缆发票写明了交货日期，却没有注明电缆长度。

entries.en: The engineer requested the original drawing after finding two different sizes listed for the Aldrey wire.
entries.zh: 工程师发现铝镁硅合金线列有两种不同尺寸后，要求查看原始图纸。

entries.en: The curator checked the older Aldrichiella drawings before accepting the proposed identification.
entries.zh: 馆员先核对旧的阿蝇属图稿，再接受所提出的鉴定结果。

entries.en: An old invoice for aldrin helped the historian identify the unnamed supplier in the correspondence.
entries.zh: 一张艾氏剂旧发票帮助历史学家查明了通信中未具名的供应商。

entries.en: The handwritten aldrine measurements were difficult to compare because the column headings had faded.
entries.zh: 那些手写的艾氏剂测量数据很难比较，因为各栏的标题已经褪色。

entries.en: An archivist found the Aldrosol order folded inside a letter from the former supplier.
entries.zh: 档案管理员在原供应商的一封信中发现了一张折起的艾氏剂订单。

entries.en: A damaged page made the old Aldurbra order difficult to match with the factory's delivery register.
entries.zh: 一页文件受损，使那份旧铝黄铜订单难以与工厂的交货登记对应起来。

entries.en: The factory cancelled its Aldurol order after discovering that the delivery date had changed.
entries.zh: 工厂发现交货日期变了，便取消了那笔聚酯树脂订单。

entries.en: The student confused the alecithal egg in the diagram with a different type on the next page.
entries.zh: 学生把图中的无卵黄卵与下一页的另一类卵弄混了。

entries.en: Our embryology tutor asked us to compare the alecithic egg with the other drawings.
entries.zh: 胚胎学导师让我们把那枚无卵黄卵与其他图示作比较。

entries.meaningZh: 亚历山德罗波尔〔旧地名〕
entries.en: An old letter from Aleksandropol had been folded inside a travel diary.
entries.zh: 一封从亚历山德罗波尔寄来的旧信，被折好夹在一本旅行日记里。

entries.meaningZh: 亚历山德罗夫斯克〔旧地名〕
entries.en: The archivist compared two postcards from Aleksandrovsk before sorting the rest of the collection.
entries.zh: 档案管理员先比较了两张来自亚历山德罗夫斯克的明信片，再整理其余藏品。

entries.meaningZh: 阿勒曼尼人〔古代族群；复数〕
entries.en: Three groups in the seminar examined different accounts of the Alemanni.
entries.zh: 研讨课上的三个小组分别研究了关于阿勒曼尼人的不同记载。

entries.en: The archive held an Alemannic dialect recording, but its original transcript was missing.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着一份阿勒曼尼方言的录音，但原始文字稿不见了。

entries.en: The museum's empty alembroth bottle was displayed beside the chemist's notebook.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那只装过氯化汞铵的空瓶与化学家的笔记本摆在一起展出。

entries.en: She chose a small piece of Alencon lace to repair the torn collar.
entries.zh: 她选了一小块阿郎松针绣花边来修补撕破的衣领。

entries.en: She found a torn length of Alenconnes beneath the other linens in the chest.
entries.zh: 她在箱子里其他亚麻织物下面找到了一段撕破的半漂白亚麻布。

entries.meaningZh: 滑头鱼亚目〔旧分类名称〕
entries.en: The zoologist compared the Alepocephaloidei drawings with the specimens listed in the old catalogue.
entries.zh: 那位动物学家把滑头鱼亚目的图画与旧目录所列的标本作了比较。

entries.en: An Aleppine brought the old photograph to the neighbourhood history group.
entries.zh: 一位阿勒颇人把那张旧照片带到了街区历史小组。

entries.meaningZh: 亚历山德里亚〔意大利城市〕
entries.en: Our train from Alessandria arrived late, so we missed the opening of the exhibition.
entries.zh: 我们从亚历山德里亚乘坐的列车晚点了，因此错过了展览开幕。

entries.en: Alethea left a spare key with her neighbour before leaving for the weekend.
entries.zh: 阿勒西娅外出度周末之前，把一把备用钥匙留给了邻居。

entries.meaningZh: 肺筋草提取物〔旧称 aletrin〕
entries.en: The historian found an aletrin advertisement among the papers left by a former pharmacist.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者在一个曾做过药剂师的人留下的文件中，发现了一则肺筋草提取物广告。

entries.en: The historical study discussed aleucemia without providing the patients' original blood counts.
entries.zh: 那项历史研究讨论了白细胞缺乏症，却未提供患者的原始血细胞计数。

entries.en: The chemist found an inconsistency between the aleudrin drawing and the sample's identification record.
entries.zh: 化学家发现，异丙肾上腺素的结构图与样品标识记录之间存在不一致之处。

entries.meaningZh: 阿路德林〔此处指异丙肾上腺素〕
entries.en: The original aleudrine research notes were unavailable, so the historian postponed the comparison.
entries.zh: 阿路德林研究的原始笔记无法取得，因此历史学家推迟了比较工作。

entries.en: Their review of the old aleukemia cases excluded records whose dates could not be confirmed.
entries.zh: 他们复核旧时白细胞缺乏症病例时，排除了日期无法确认的记录。

entries.meaningZh: 血小板缺乏症〔旧术语的一个义项〕
entries.en: An old account of aleukia was missing the laboratory appendix referenced in its introduction.
entries.zh: 一份有关血小板缺乏症的旧记述缺少引言中提到的实验室附录。

entries.en: The pathologist questioned the report's description of an aleukocytic lesion.
entries.zh: 那位病理学家质疑了报告将该病变描述为无白细胞病变的说法。

entries.en: The historical records of aleukocytosis used inconsistent units, making their figures difficult to compare.
entries.zh: 那些有关白细胞减少的历史记录使用的单位不一致，导致数值难以比较。

entries.en: The student drew an aleuriospore beside the fungal thread and left room for annotations.
entries.zh: 学生在菌丝旁画了一个粉状孢子，并留出了作注释的地方。

entries.en: The archivist separated the Aleurisma photographs from unrelated images before digitizing the collection.
entries.zh: 档案员先把糊蕈属的照片与不相关的图像分开，再将馆藏资料数字化。

entries.en: The historian found an unopened packet of aleuronat among the bakery's old supplies.
entries.zh: 历史学家在面包房的旧物资中发现了一包未开封的高麦蛋白面粉。

entries.en: The illustrator added an inset showing the aleuronoid material at a larger scale.
entries.zh: 绘图员加了一幅插图，以更大的比例显示那种麦粉样物质。

entries.en: The diagram showed an aleuroplast within a plant cell, but its caption was missing.
entries.zh: 图中画出了植物细胞内的一个蛋白质体，但图注缺失了。

entries.meaningZh: 亚历山大勒塔〔城市旧称〕
entries.en: The faded postcard showed Alexandretta, but the date on the back was unreadable.
entries.zh: 那张褪色的明信片上是亚历山大勒塔，但背面的日期已无法辨认。

entries.en: A small piece of alexandrolite remained in the museum's oldest mineral drawer.
entries.zh: 博物馆最旧的矿物抽屉里还留着一小块铬粘土。

entries.en: The engineer redrew the Alexbow after finding a missing section of the archived plans.
entries.zh: 工程师找到归档图纸中缺失的部分后，重新绘制了弓形破冰扫冰装置。

entries.meaningZh: 外用解毒药〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The medical historian questioned the evidence offered for the old alexeterium.
entries.zh: 那位医学史研究者质疑了为那种旧时外用解毒药提供的证据。

entries.en: The report compared the alexidine measurements from two laboratories, but one data sheet was missing.
entries.zh: 报告比较了两家实验室的阿来西定测量结果，但其中一份数据表不见了。

entries.en: The historian compared two early accounts of alexinic activity without treating either as conclusive.
entries.zh: 历史研究者比较了两份关于补体活性的早期记述，但并未把其中任何一份视为定论。

entries.en: The historian questioned the alexipharmac claims made in the merchant's handwritten advertisement.
entries.zh: 历史学家对商人手写广告中关于解毒作用的宣称提出了质疑。

entries.en: The historical account of an alexipharmacon gave no reliable evidence of its effectiveness.
entries.zh: 那份关于一种解毒药的历史记述，没有提供其有效性的可靠证据。

entries.en: The catalogue described the mixture as alexipyretic, but the historian found no supporting case records.
entries.zh: 目录把那种混合物描述为具有退热作用，但历史学家没有找到支持这一说法的病例记录。

entries.meaningZh: 产补体白细胞〔旧医学假说用语〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the evidence for the alexocyte's supposed role in immunity.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者质疑了这种产补体白细胞在免疫中所谓作用的证据。

entries.meaningZh: 补体结合抗原〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The reviewer questioned whether the reported alexofixagen reacted as the author had claimed.
entries.zh: 审稿人质疑，报告中的补体结合抗原是否如作者所称的那样发生反应。

entries.meaningZh: 睾丸间质细胞功能缺失〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical case report discussed aleydigism but offered no clear explanation for its cause.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例报告讨论了睾丸间质细胞功能缺失，却没有清楚解释其原因。

entries.en: The inspector compared the Alfacron shipment numbers with those on the warehouse's old invoices.
entries.zh: 检查员把碘硫磷的货运编号与仓库旧发票上的编号作了比较。

entries.en: A missing date made it difficult to trace the alfaxalone sample in the laboratory records.
entries.zh: 由于日期缺失，很难在实验室记录中追溯那份阿法沙龙样品。

entries.en: The collector asked whether the Alfenide fitting belonged to the original object or a later repair.
entries.zh: 收藏者问，那件镍黄铜配件是原物的一部分，还是后来修补时加上的。

entries.en: The museum kept the Alfenol specimen beside the correspondence explaining how it entered the collection.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那件铁铝合金标本与说明其入藏经过的往来信件放在一起。

entries.en: The museum's Alfero sample had been separated from the notebook describing its purchase.
entries.zh: 博物馆的阿尔费罗铝铁合金样品，与记述其采购情况的笔记本分开存放了。

entries.en: An unpaid Alferon invoice turned up among the workshop's old maintenance records.
entries.zh: 一张尚未付款的阿尔费隆耐酸合金发票，出现在车间的旧维修记录中。

entries.en: Mr Alferov carried the chairs upstairs while the rest of us arranged the tables.
entries.zh: 阿尔费罗夫先生把椅子搬上楼，我们其余的人则摆放桌子。

entries.en: Ms Alfieri returned the lost notebook with a note tucked inside the cover.
entries.zh: 阿尔菲耶里女士归还了丢失的笔记本，封面内夹着一张便条。

entries.en: The pedologist examined an Alfisol profile before discussing the survey notes with the students.
entries.zh: 土壤学家先观察了一处淋溶土剖面，再与学生讨论调查笔记。

entries.en: Alfreda had packed the sandwiches, but everyone had forgotten to bring something to drink.
entries.zh: 阿弗丽达已经装好了三明治，但大家都忘了带饮料。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔文型的〔如阿尔文型波动〕
entries.en: The lecturer replaced an unclear diagram of Alfvenic fluctuations with a simpler sketch.
entries.zh: 讲师把一幅说明阿尔文型波动的模糊示意图，换成了一幅较简单的草图。

entries.en: The supplier could not trace that batch of algaecide because the invoice was missing.
entries.zh: 由于发票不见了，供应商无法追溯那批除藻剂。

entries.en: The lecturer distinguished algaesthesis from the emotional distress that may accompany pain.
entries.zh: 讲师区分了痛觉与可能伴随疼痛出现的心理痛苦。

entries.meaningZh: 长角豆树〔本例取树木义〕
entries.en: We rested beneath an algaroba while waiting for the gardener to return.
entries.zh: 我们在一棵长角豆树下休息，等着园丁回来。

entries.en: His diary described an algedonic experience in which delight was inseparable from pain.
entries.zh: 他的日记描述了一次欣快与痛感交织的体验，快乐与痛苦难以分开。

entries.en: We marked Algenib on the star chart before packing the telescope away.
entries.zh: 我们先在星图上标出了壁宿一，然后才收起望远镜。

entries.en: The exhibition included an Algerine portrait borrowed from a private collection.
entries.zh: 展览中有一幅从私人收藏借来的阿尔及利亚肖像画。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔杰式的；提倡艰苦创业精神的
entries.en: The editor felt that the novel's Algerish optimism made the ending too predictable.
entries.zh: 编辑觉得，小说中阿尔杰式的乐观精神使结局太容易猜到。

entries.en: The old case report mentioned algesia without explaining how the heightened pain sensitivity had been assessed.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告提到了痛觉过敏，却没有说明如何评估这种对疼痛更敏感的状态。

entries.en: The case notes described algesic symptoms, but the patient's own account was missing.
entries.zh: 病例记录描述了疼痛症状，但缺少患者本人的叙述。

entries.en: The curator could not open the algesichronometer display because its key had been misplaced.
entries.zh: 由于钥匙放错了地方，策展人无法打开陈列痛觉时间计的展柜。

entries.en: The review compared several proposed algesiogenic factors without accepting any single explanation.
entries.zh: 这篇综述比较了几种被提出的致痛因素，但没有采纳任何单一解释。

entries.en: A photograph of the algesiometer was missing from the museum catalogue's final draft.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录的最终稿中缺少了那台痛觉计的照片。

entries.en: The lecture on algesthesis ended early when a power cut darkened the hall.
entries.zh: 关于痛觉的讲座因停电导致礼堂陷入黑暗而提前结束。

entries.en: The analyst set the algestone sample aside until its torn identification label could be replaced.
entries.zh: 分析人员把那份阿尔孕酮样品单独搁置，等待更换已撕破的识别标签。

entries.en: The lecturer added a section on Algic after students requested a broader comparison of language families.
entries.zh: 学生要求更广泛地比较不同语系后，讲师增补了一个关于阿尔吉克语系的部分。

entries.en: A damaged container of algicide was listed separately in the warehouse inventory report.
entries.zh: 盛放除藻剂的一只受损容器被单独列在仓库盘点报告中。

entries.meaningZh: 藻酸的〔本例用 alginic acid 表示藻酸〕
entries.en: The revised inventory listed alginic acid separately from the other materials awaiting analysis.
entries.zh: 修订后的清单把藻酸与其他待分析材料分开列出。

entries.meaningZh: 藻杆菌属〔历史分类名称〕
entries.en: The old classification chart placed Alginobacter in a separate column from the other bacterial genera.
entries.zh: 那张旧分类表把藻杆菌属与其他细菌属分列在不同栏中。

entries.meaningZh: 藻单孢菌属〔历史分类名称〕
entries.en: The lecturer discussed Alginomonas while comparing several historical schemes for classifying bacteria.
entries.zh: 讲师在比较几种历史上的细菌分类方案时谈到了藻单孢菌属。

entries.en: The old case report mentioned alginuresis but gave no account of the patient's later condition.
entries.zh: 那份旧病例报告提到了痛性排尿，却没有记述患者后来的状况。

entries.meaningZh: 引起肌肉疼痛的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The physician questioned the old report's account of algiomuscular effects.
entries.zh: 旧报告记述了引起肌肉疼痛的作用，医生对此提出了质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 疼痛相关血管活动的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: Several pages were missing from the old lecture notes on algiovascular changes.
entries.zh: 那份讨论疼痛相关血管变化的旧讲义缺失了几页。

entries.en: The alglucerase research file was returned because several pages had been scanned out of order.
entries.zh: 那份阿尔葡西酶研究档案因几页扫描顺序有误而被退回。

entries.en: A scratch across the algochronometer's dial obscured one of the markings.
entries.zh: 痛觉时间计的表盘上有一道划痕，遮住了其中一个刻度。

entries.en: An algologist joined the coastal survey after the team found several unfamiliar specimens.
entries.zh: 调查队发现几种不熟悉的标本后，一位藻类学家加入了沿海调查。

entries.en: The astronomer compared the Algols in the survey without assuming that their orbits were identical.
entries.zh: 天文学家比较了巡天中的大陵双星，没有预先假定它们的轨道完全相同。

entries.meaningZh: 寒冷感；寒战〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: Her diary described a sudden algor, but gave no clue about its cause.
entries.zh: 她的日记描述了突然出现的一阵寒冷感，却没有交代原因。

entries.meaningZh: 海藻病；藻害〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared the early accounts of algosis before discussing their reliability.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者先比较了早期有关海藻病的记述，再讨论这些记述是否可靠。

entries.meaningZh: 疼痛相关血管活动的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The lecturer questioned an old explanation of algovascular changes rather than presenting it as established fact.
entries.zh: 讲师对一种有关疼痛相关血管变化的旧解释提出了质疑，而没有将其作为已确立的事实来介绍。

entries.en: The illustrator drew an algum beside a wall in the imagined royal garden.
entries.zh: 插画师在想象中的皇家花园里，画了一株长在墙边的檀香树。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔罕布拉宫装饰风格的
entries.en: Her Alhambraic ceiling design looked very different when viewed from the entrance.
entries.zh: 从入口看过去，她设计的阿尔罕布拉宫装饰风格的天花板显得很不一样。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔罕布拉宫式的；装饰华丽的
entries.en: The architect removed the Alhambresque ornaments from the drawing after the client requested a simpler hall.
entries.zh: 客户要求大厅更简洁后，建筑师删去了图纸中的阿尔罕布拉宫式装饰。

entries.en: The photograph of Alhena was blurred, so we returned to our earlier observations.
entries.zh: 井宿三的照片模糊不清，因此我们重新查阅了先前的观测记录。

entries.en: A strand of Aliaf had become tangled with the other fibres in the sample box.
entries.zh: 一根阿莱夫尼龙长丝与样本盒里的其他纤维缠在了一起。

entries.en: In his old travel diary, the visitor praised the inn's plain but alible fare.
entries.zh: 在那本旧旅行日记中，旅人称赞旅店的饭菜虽简单却富有营养。

entries.meaningZh: 双草混剂〔混合型除草剂〕
entries.en: The historian compared the old Alicep orders with the estate's surviving field diaries.
entries.zh: 那位历史研究者把双草混剂的旧订单与庄园留存的田间日记作了比较。

entries.en: The student sorted the alicyclic compounds into a separate group before comparing their structures.
entries.zh: 学生先把脂环族化合物单独分成一组，再比较它们的结构。

entries.en: The old report on alidase included a handwritten correction beside the sample number.
entries.zh: 那份有关透明质酸酶的旧报告在样本编号旁有一处手写更正。

entries.en: The historical case description mentioned alienia but contained no accompanying anatomical illustration.
entries.zh: 那份历史病例描述提到了无脾畸形，却没有附上解剖插图。

entries.en: The researcher could not compare the aliesterase results because the sample codes were inconsistent.
entries.zh: 由于样本代码不一致，研究人员无法比较脂族酯酶的结果。

entries.en: My cousin sent the parcel from Aligarh, but the address label had come loose.
entries.zh: 我的一位堂表亲从阿里格尔寄来了包裹，但地址标签已经松脱了。

entries.en: The student added the missing alinasal labels before submitting her anatomical drawing.
entries.zh: 学生先补上遗漏的鼻翼部位标注，再提交自己的解剖图。

entries.en: The student circled Alioth on the chart before comparing the chart with last night's photograph.
entries.zh: 学生先在星图上圈出了玉衡，再将星图与昨晚的照片作比较。

entries.en: The old paper described an alipoidic preparation without explaining how its composition had been checked.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论文描述了一种无脂制备物，却未说明如何检查其组成。

entries.en: The archive contained an Alipur invoice, but the corresponding farm account was missing.
entries.zh: 档案中有一张环氯混剂除草剂的发票，但对应的农场账目不见了。

entries.en: The botanist compared the Alismaceae illustrations in two old floras and noted their different arrangements.
entries.zh: 植物学家比较了两本旧植物志中的泽泻科插图，并记下它们不同的编排方式。
